title: Compare app, Git and feature scopes explicitly
preconditions: Use two named features one/two with one owned changed line each, one unowned changed line, and health problems in both features.

Intent clarification pending: the current evaluator includes unowned lines in every feature. The planned feature check retains the recorded only-named-feature requirement and may expose this difference.

steps.action: Evaluate areas directly with ScopeApp, code targets item:a/item:b, one active story linked only from item:a, and no diff.
steps.expected_result: Implementation has no diff obligation, stories count two code targets with one covered, and design has one uncovered story.
Scope is change, based on the selected Git comparison.

steps.action: Evaluate areas directly with ScopeChange, Feature one, owned atoms for one/two, an unowned atom, and health problems for each feature.
steps.expected_result: Only feature-one facts contribute to feature-one obligations and health; feature-two and unowned facts are not attributed to feature one.

steps.action: Run check with no scope flag, --against main and --feature one respectively on the corresponding authored fixture.
steps.expected_result: No flags select app; --against selects the comparison; --feature one evaluates only feature-one facts.

expected_result: Each selector evaluates its recorded scope; the unowned-line difference remains an explicit unresolved product question.
